projectDescription: A research dataset of crypto trading signals scraped from the WallstreetQueenOfficial Telegram channel and converted into structured JSON using an LLM extraction pipeline, intended as input for backtesting signal-following strategies.
keyFeatures: 65 monthly folders of raw Telegram channel posts (9,189 messages, May 2021 – Sep 2026)
921 LLM-extracted structured trading signals (521 long, 294 short, 106 wait)
82 USDT symbols with gap-free Binance spot 1-minute candle coverage over the full range
Resumable per-month signal generation using Ollama (gemma4:31b-cloud) via json-inference
Month-specific Mustache prompt templates that adapt to evolving post formats
Keyword pre-filter to isolate actionable entry posts before LLM extraction
Go/no-go separability check and exit-calibration architecture (ARCHITECTURE.md)
Parallel batch-run scripts for all 65 months (Linux shell + Windows bat)
publicApiSurface: content/<mon>_<year>/generate-signals.mjs — streams messages.jsonl → appends to signals.jsonl
content/<mon>_<year>/assets/messages.jsonl — raw Telegram posts (id, content, channel, date, photo)
content/<mon>_<year>/assets/signals.jsonl — LLM verdicts (messageId, symbol, entry, url, message)
content/<mon>_<year>/prompt.mustache — Mustache extraction prompt for the period
assets/target_tickers.txt — 82 *USDT symbols with full candle coverage
scripts/fetch_messages.mjs — scrape channel day-by-day via telegram-reader
scripts/fetch_photos.mjs — save post photos as JPEG
scripts/read_posts.mjs — print recent or specific posts
scripts/check_filter.mjs — find signal-like posts dropped by the keyword pre-filter
scripts/validate_prompt.mjs — run prompt against known posts
scripts/read_months.mjs — collect tickers and check against Binance spot
scripts/check_candles.mjs — verify candle coverage per ticker
scripts/read_cache.mjs — inspect the LLM cache in MongoDB
